description: Cutover step P2-pre: the new controller code alone, with the fleet classes still absent. Rollbackable with a Worker rollback.

rollback.why: EXECUTOR_TELEMETRY holds the telemetry settings and, beside them, the build version, the pinned upstream commit. A release that moves that pin, or changes the telemetry settings, changes it, and Cloudflare then refuses to roll a Worker back across it without force; the earlier version comes back with the value it ran with.
